title: Female Founders Institute Selects Women-Owned 9X Digital Inc. as Official Digital Marketing Partner | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
DETROIT - April 16, 2025 - The Female Founders Institute (FFI), a mission-driven organization committed to empowering women entrepreneurs, is excited to announce its partnership with 9X Digital Inc., a women-owned, full-service digital marketing agency based in West Jordan, Utah.
As FFI’s official digital marketing partner, 9X Digital Inc. will lead in areas such as strategy, branding, SEO, web design, and social media marketing to enhance FFI’s growth and reach. The agency will provide tailored digital solutions that align with FFI’s mission to support women founders.
“We’re thrilled to work with 9X Digital, a company that shares our values and understands the importance of purposeful storytelling,” said Rose Vitale, founder of the Female Founders Institute. “Diana Affandi and her team bring both expertise and a deep commitment to the empowerment of women entrepreneurs, making them the ideal partner for FFI.”
Through this collaboration, FFI’s members will gain access to a variety of exclusive benefits, including co-hosted workshops, marketing coaching sessions, and educational resources to help women founders enhance their digital presence and grow their businesses in a competitive landscape.
Diana Affandi, Creative Director of 9X Digital Inc., will lead the partnership and work closely with the FFI leadership team to create impactful campaigns that highlight FFI’s programs and initiatives through 2025 and beyond.
“As a women-owned agency, we’re honored to partner with FFI, an organization that is creating real change for women entrepreneurs,” said Diana Affandi. “At 9X Digital, we’re passionate about helping businesses grow with purpose—especially when it’s for something that empowers others.”
This partnership is a significant step as FFI continues to expand nationally, launching new initiatives focused on mentorship, education, and expanding access to resources for women-led startups.
About Female Founders Institute
Founded by investor and entrepreneur Rose Vitale, the Female Founders Institute is a global platform focused on empowering women entrepreneurs through mentorship and education. FFI is dedicated to building a more inclusive and supportive entrepreneurial ecosystem.
About 9X Digital Inc.
9X Digital Inc. is a women-owned, full-service digital agency based in West Jordan, Utah. The agency specializes in SEO, web design, social media marketing, and customized digital solutions to help purpose-driven businesses thrive. Led by Creative Director Diana Affandi, 9X Digital partners with clients who are ready to grow with intention and impact.
